caption: The drawing features three stylized deer, each depicted in a different color and pose, arranged vertically on a plain beige background. The top deer is rendered in a mustard yellow color with red outline accents, a blue eye, and blue antlers. The middle deer is blue with a red eye, red antlers, and yellow oval markings along its side. The bottom deer is red with blue and yellow oval markings on its body and neck, blue hooves, and blue antlers. Each deer is outlined in a contrasting color, and their bodies are somewhat geometric with elongated limbs and necks. Beneath the illustrations, centered text reads: "FROM CERAMICS AND ILLUMINATED WRITINGS 1773 to 1811." At the bottom edge, additional text gives attribution: "FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA PLATE No. 3. INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNA ART PROJECT W P A."
title: Plate 3: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
